E0 recognizes variable-invalid residues; Ek recognizes the failed Boolean assignment modulo at most three variable primes. Union complement equals the candidate full intersection after variable-validity, with the local nonBoolean qualification.

Definitions, stable capacity, least action/root-last comparison, cofactor trees, membership argument and simple-digraph historical question. Title-page footnote identifies Levine as Senior Thesis Advisor, not coauthor. Root-last process and full section4.1 mass-comparison interface read. The discussion is an antecedent; candidate does not claim novel root-last method or transfer the older unfinished large-multiplicity reduction.

Entire three-page original read: bidirected rim plus center graph, 3n-5 chips, exponential terminating recurrence. Polynomial-chip long simple games already prior; this alone supplies no SAT many-one reduction.
Equation4.2 and its proof read from retained v1: log p_k<=log k+loglog k+1 for k>=2 gives p_k<=e klogk and hence sufficient3(n+1)^2 bound including n1 endpoint.

Actual journal T21 with full Lemmas22/23 hardness proof and source model definitions read. Faces may branch, require an arc particle and a vertex particle, update arc states; specified final arc/particle targets include literal sinks. Candidate fixed-output conservative HALTING does not follow from simply identifying these models. Actual journal and arXiv SHA differ.
Definition6.5 and Corollary6.6, and immediate given-input discussion read: sandpilization preserves halting on all inputs, not supplied reset-state input outcome absent an additional bridge.

Actual title names sole author Javier Esparza. Selected 1-safe local conflict/free-choice interfaces read. Formula glyph corruption limits interpretation; no unavailable weighted-net proof or universal inapplicability is certified. Cheng-Esparza-Palsberg definitions p4 separately show set-valued flow and threshold-one enabling.
